notes: Six lines by five characters, matching the prompt's speaker labels. The prompt's 'Protection and brightening, in one.' line is NOT spoken in the video (cut at 17 s), so it is omitted. The White Cast and Dullness villains appear on screen but are silent. The UV villain's original voice is fairly high (~248 Hz), so it gets villain fx plus -3 st to sound menacing. Tube, Purple Tint and Niacinamide all sit around 190-220 Hz in the original, so Purple Tint gets +3 and Niacinamide +2 to keep the three voices apart. The SPF Shield is the only deep voice (~121 Hz). The tube's two lines differ in pitch (221 vs 188 Hz) but the prompt labels both as SUNSCREEN. Whisper's voice_cluster_hint was ignored.
